Where the patients endotracheal tube connects to the ventilator circuit is called the Y. The distance between the Y and the endotube is mechanical deadspace. Essentially, an area where exhaled gasses will collect and be delivered back to the patient. When we start adding CO2 and flow sensors at the Y, the deadspace can become greater than the volume being delivered to the patient especially if we are talking about premature babies.
